pharm: Binds ergosterol in the fungal cell membrane, forming pores that cause leakage of intracellular contents and fungal cell death; fungicidal/fungistatic against Candida.
quick: Oral candidiasis: 400,000-600,000 units swish-and-swallow four times daily; intestinal: 500,000-1,000,000 units three times daily
Oral suspension - retain in mouth before swallowing; not affected by food
Considered low risk; minimal systemic absorption (vaginal use category historically A/C)
summary: Nystatin is a polyene antifungal active against Candida species. Given orally it is not significantly absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract, so it acts locally to treat oral, esophageal (limited), and intestinal candidiasis; topical and vaginal forms treat cutaneous and mucocutaneous candidal infections. It is generally well tolerated; high oral doses may cause nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Because of negligible systemic absorption, it is not used for systemic fungal infections and requires no renal or hepatic dose adjustment.
indications: Treatment of oral cavity candidiasis (oral suspension/pastilles)
Treatment of cutaneous and mucocutaneous candidal infections of the skin (topical cream, ointment, powder)

dosage.d: 400,000 to 600,000 units four times daily; retain in mouth as long as possible then swallow
dosage.n: Continue at least 48 h after clinical cure

dosage.d: 200,000 units four times daily (100,000 units in each side of mouth)
Apply cream/ointment/powder (100,000 units/g) to affected area two to three times daily
100,000 units (one vaginal tablet) inserted high in vagina once or twice daily for 14 days

admin: Oral suspension: shake well; retain in the mouth and swish before swallowing for maximal mucosal contact
For infants and young children, place half the dose in each cheek pouch
Continue oral/intestinal therapy for at least 48 hours after symptoms resolve to prevent relapse
Topical powder is preferred for moist areas and intertriginous lesions
Vaginal tablets are inserted high into the vagina; complete the full course even during menses
moa: Nystatin is a polyene macrolide that binds preferentially to ergosterol, the principal sterol in the fungal cytoplasmic membrane. This binding alters membrane permeability by forming transmembrane channels (pores), leading to leakage of potassium and other essential intracellular components and ultimately fungal cell death. It is fungistatic to fungicidal against Candida species depending on concentration; it has no clinically useful activity against bacteria, protozoa, or viruses.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity to nystatin or any component of the formulation
relative: Not for systemic mycoses (no meaningful systemic absorption)
monitor: Clinical response of the candidal infection

preg: Nystatin is poorly absorbed and is generally regarded as low risk in pregnancy. Topical and vaginal forms are used for candidiasis in pregnancy; use only when clearly needed and as directed.
lact: Because systemic absorption is negligible, nystatin is considered compatible with breastfeeding. Maternal use of oral, topical, or vaginal nystatin is not expected to harm the nursing infant.
renal: No dose adjustment is required. Nystatin is not significantly absorbed from intact skin, mucous membranes, or the gastrointestinal tract, so it does not accumulate in renal impairment.
hepatic: No dose adjustment is required because of negligible systemic absorption.

minor: No clinically significant systemic drug interactions are expected due to lack of absorption
interactions.food: Food does not meaningfully affect activity; oral suspension should contact mucosa before swallowing.
interactions.diagnostics: No significant laboratory test interference reported.

counsel: For oral thrush, swish the liquid around your mouth and hold it as long as you can before swallowing
Keep using the medicine for the full prescribed time, even after symptoms improve
For skin infections keep the area clean and dry; powder works well in skin folds
Stop and seek care if you develop a rash, swelling, or trouble breathing
This medicine treats yeast infections only and does not work for bacterial or viral infections
pk: Local antifungal effect begins on contact
Not meaningful systemically (acts locally; excreted unchanged in feces after oral use)
Local effect maintained by repeated daily dosing
Store at controlled room temperature; protect oral suspension from freezing and light
pearls: Essentially not absorbed - safe across renal/hepatic impairment and useful only for local candidiasis
Swish-and-swallow technique and prolonged mucosal contact maximize efficacy for oral thrush
Not effective for systemic candidiasis or dermatophyte (tinea) infections
Continue therapy 48 hours past symptom resolution to reduce relapse
Combination products with topical corticosteroids exist for inflamed candidal dermatitis
missed: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is nearly time for the next dose, skip the missed one and continue your usual schedule. Do not double the dose.
overdose: Oral overdose may cause gastrointestinal upset (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea) but no serious systemic toxicity because the drug is not absorbed. Manage supportively with fluids as needed.
